# Analysis: Walmart FY2018-FY2020 3-Year Average Unadjusted EBITDA % Margin

To calculate the unadjusted EBITDA % margin, I first need to determine unadjusted EBITDA for each year by adding operating income and depreciation and amortization.

**FY2018 Unadjusted EBITDA:**
Operating income of $20,437M plus depreciation and amortization of $10,529M equals $30,966M.
This represents a margin of 30,966 divided by net sales of 495,761, or 6.2%.

**FY2019 Unadjusted EBITDA:**
Operating income of $21,957M plus depreciation and amortization of $10,678M equals $32,635M.
This represents a margin of 32,635 divided by net sales of 510,329, or 6.4%.

**FY2020 Unadjusted EBITDA:**
Operating income of $20,568M plus depreciation and amortization of $10,987M equals $31,555M.
This represents a margin of 31,555 divided by net sales of 591,926, or 5.3%.

**3-Year Average:**
The three-year average unadjusted EBITDA % margin is the average of 6.2%, 6.4%, and 5.3%, which equals **6.0%**.
